documents.title: Q3 hard close locked at WD+5, two days faster than Q2. US gross-to-net accruals are still the last item to lock
documents.source_ref: SDP Group Close Control Tower — 8 close feeds, September 2026 quarter-end
documents.excerpt: The September quarter-end close locked at WD+5 against WD+7 in Q2. 91.4% of balance-sheet reconciliations were auto-certified, and USD 486M was still unreconciled at WD+3. 61% of that (USD 297M) sits in US gross-to-net accruals, driven by the Medicare Part D redesign and 340B contract-pharmacy claims.

documents.title: Intercompany mismatch of USD 212M at quarter-end: goods in transit to the US and CNY rate timing
documents.source_ref: SDP Intercompany & Consolidation — 7 flow types, USD 34.0B of annual intra-group flows
documents.excerpt: Of USD 8.5B of Q3 intercompany flows, USD 212M was not agreed by WD+2: product supply to the US in transit at 30 September (USD 96M), AstraZeneca China CNY rate timing (USD 58M), Alexion recharge cost-centre mapping (USD 41M) and royalty true-ups (USD 17M). Every break now has an owner and an evidence pack.

documents.title: USD 118M of Q3 clinical trial accruals were still estimate-only at WD+2
documents.source_ref: SDP Close Control — CRO and investigator-site accruals
documents.excerpt: Clinical trial accruals of USD 1.6B for Q3 were 92.6% confirmed by CRO and site data at WD+2. The remaining USD 118M is concentrated in three late-stage oncology programmes with new CRO partners. The accrual agent matches patient-visit data to contract milestones and proposes the true-up for controller approval.

documents.title: RSG programme: up to USD 2.0B of restructuring to tag once and track to Core through 2029
documents.source_ref: AstraZeneca 9M & Q3 2026 results (30 Oct 2026) — Reshaping for Sustainable Growth
documents.excerpt: Reshaping for Sustainable Growth is expected to cost up to USD 2.0B in one-time restructuring and to deliver USD 1.5B of annualised pre-tax run-rate benefits, essentially complete by the end of 2029. Each charge needs one tag that flows into provisions, the Reported-to-Core bridge and the controls evidence, instead of being rebuilt in each entity workbook.

documents.title: Provision 29 declaration for FY2026: 37 control deficiencies open, 2 rated significant
documents.source_ref: SDP Controls & Non-Financial Risk — 1,284 key controls
documents.excerpt: The UK Corporate Governance Code Provision 29 board declaration on material controls applies from FY2026. Of 1,284 key financial and non-financial controls in scope, 92% have been tested for the year and 46% are tested automatically from Snowflake data. 37 deficiencies are open; the two significant ones are SAP access in China and third-party HCP payment approvals.
